title: Chris Kelly and the Parita and Rampart headquarters
summary: Musicians like Chris Kelly gathered at Parita and Rampart to get jobs; Bob Lyon again.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: I was going to ask you about guys like Chris Kelly. Did your husband ever play with Chris Kelly? Oh, yeah.

Yeah, I remember him. Yeah, I hope to tell you. It was all kind of like right hand vows. You know, they had a certain bunch like Chris Kelly and all them boys. They're like, this was right together. Whenever you want them, all of them, you go right there, Parita and Ramport. They used to get all their jobs from right there, Parita and Ramport, signing up. Everybody come in town. That's where their headquarters was.
They made plenty of money then. And poor Bob Lyon. Bob Lyon was a great musician. He was a fine bass player.
